Name: Hairstyles recolored and a new Hairstyle Update
Author: alicedafox
Description:
Hey guys,

I recolored some hairstyles from other artists and uploaded them on the Forum.
Now I made a new update with some of my own hairstyles and I wanted to share them with you!
[b]
Please read the thread at the forum for more informations![/b]
[b]→ [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/hairstyles-recolored-update-new-hairstyles-21-04-2017.130942/ ]here[/url][/b]

[b]Installation instructions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Download the mod
[*]Extract the archive
[*]Go to Stardew Valley/Content/Characters/Farmer
[*]Replace the hairstyles.xnb file with the provided
[*][b][color=#ff0000]Remember to make a backup of your files![/color][/b]
[/list]


[b]Information about the ombre hair :[/b]
[u]To see them correctly you have to change the controls to white! Otherwise they may wont have the ombre effect![/u]
